00177 NSString *DescrptionOfEndpoint(MIDIEndpointRef ref)
00178 {
00179     NSString *string = nil;
00180 
00181     MIDIEntityRef entity = 0;
00182     MIDIEndpointGetEntity(ref, &entity);
00183 
00184     CFPropertyListRef properties = nil;
00185     OSStatus s = MIDIObjectGetProperties(entity, &properties, true);
00186     if (s)
00187         string = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"Error getting properties: %@",
00188                   [NSError errorWithDomain:NSMachErrorDomain code:s userInfo:nil] ];
00189     else
00190         string = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@", properties];
00191     CFRelease(properties);
00192 
00193     return string;
00194 }

00196 - (void) connectSource:(MIDIEndpointRef)source
00197 {
00198     ++numberOfConnectedDevices;
00199   
00200   NSEnumerator *enumerator = [delegates objectEnumerator];
00201   id<MidiInputDelegate> delegate;
00202   while ((delegate = [enumerator nextObject])) 
00203   {
00204     [delegate midiInput:self
00205             event:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"Added a source: %@", DescrptionOfEndpoint(source)]];
00206   }
00207   
00208     OSStatus s = MIDIPortConnectSource(inputPort, source, self);
00209     NSLogError(s, @"Connecting to MIDI source");
00210 }
00211 
00212 - (void) disconnectSource:(MIDIEndpointRef)source
00213 {
00214     --numberOfConnectedDevices;
00215 
00216   NSEnumerator *enumerator = [delegates objectEnumerator];
00217   id<MidiInputDelegate> delegate;
00218   while ((delegate = [enumerator nextObject])) 
00219   {
00220     [delegate midiInput:self event:@"Removed a source"];
00221   }
00222     
00223     OSStatus s = MIDIPortDisconnectSource(inputPort, source);
00224     NSLogError(s, @"Disconnecting from MIDI source");
00225 }

00247 - (void) scanExistingDevices
00248 {
00249     const ItemCount numberOfDestinations = MIDIGetNumberOfDestinations();
00250     const ItemCount numberOfSources      = MIDIGetNumberOfSources();
00251 
00252     for (ItemCount index = 0; index < numberOfDestinations; ++index)
00253         [self connectDestination:MIDIGetDestination(index)];
00254     for (ItemCount index = 0; index < numberOfSources; ++index)
00255         [self connectSource:MIDIGetSource(index)];
00256 
00257     numberOfConnectedDevices = numberOfSources;
00258 }

00263 - (void) midiNotifyAdd:(const MIDIObjectAddRemoveNotification *)notification
00264 {
00265     if (notification->childType == kMIDIObjectType_Destination)
00266         [self connectDestination:(MIDIEndpointRef)notification->child];
00267     else if (notification->childType == kMIDIObjectType_Source)
00268         [self connectSource:(MIDIEndpointRef)notification->child];
00269 }
00270 
00271 - (void) midiNotifyRemove:(const MIDIObjectAddRemoveNotification *)notification
00272 {
00273     if (notification->childType == kMIDIObjectType_Destination)
00274         [self disconnectDestination:(MIDIEndpointRef)notification->child];
00275     else if (notification->childType == kMIDIObjectType_Source)
00276         [self disconnectSource:(MIDIEndpointRef)notification->child];
00277 }
00278 
00279 - (void) midiNotify:(const MIDINotification*)notification
00280 {
00281     switch (notification->messageID)
00282     {
00283         case kMIDIMsgObjectAdded:
00284             [self midiNotifyAdd:(const MIDIObjectAddRemoveNotification *)notification];
00285             break;
00286         case kMIDIMsgObjectRemoved:
00287             [self midiNotifyRemove:(const MIDIObjectAddRemoveNotification *)notification];
00288             break;
00289         case kMIDIMsgSetupChanged:
00290         case kMIDIMsgPropertyChanged:
00291         case kMIDIMsgThruConnectionsChanged:
00292         case kMIDIMsgSerialPortOwnerChanged:
00293         case kMIDIMsgIOError:
00294             break;
00295     }
00296 }

00307 // NOTE: Called on a separate high-priority thread, not the main runloop
00308 - (void) midiRead:(const MIDIPacketList *)pktlist midiSource:(void*)source
00309 {
00310   NSAutoreleasePool * pool = [[NSAutoreleasePool alloc] init];
00311     
00312   const MIDIPacket *packet = &pktlist->packet[0];
00313     for (int i = 0; i < pktlist->numPackets; ++i)
00314     {
00315 //    UInt64 time = packet->timeStamp;
00316 //    NSLog(@"timeStamp: %lld", time);
00317     
00318     ByteArray messages(packet->length, (unsigned char*)packet->data, false);
00319     
00320     NSEnumerator *enumerator = [delegates objectEnumerator];
00321     id<MidiInputDelegate> delegate;
00322     while ((delegate = [enumerator nextObject])) 
00323     {
00324       [delegate handleIncomingMidiMessage: messages midiSource: source];
00325     }     
00326     
00327     MidiInputSender::getInstance().sendIncomingMidiMessage(source, messages);
00328     
00329         packet = MIDIPacketNext(packet);
00330     } 
00331   
00332   [pool release];
00333 }
00334

00336 {
00337     MidiInput *self = (MidiInput*)readProcRefCon;
00338     [self midiRead:pktlist midiSource:srcConnRefCon];
00339 }

00343 
00344 - (void) sendMidi:(const UInt8*)data size:(UInt32)size
00345 {
00346     NSLog(@"%s(%u bytes to core MIDI)", __func__, unsigned(size));
00347     assert(size < 65536);
00348     Byte packetBuffer[size+100];
00349     MIDIPacketList *packetList = (MIDIPacketList*)packetBuffer;
00350     MIDIPacket     *packet     = MIDIPacketListInit(packetList);
00351 
00352     packet = MIDIPacketListAdd(packetList, sizeof(packetBuffer), packet, 0, size, data);
00353 
00354     for (ItemCount index = 0; index < MIDIGetNumberOfDestinations(); ++index)
00355     {
00356         MIDIEndpointRef outputEndpoint = MIDIGetDestination(index);
00357         if (outputEndpoint)
00358         {
00359             // Send it
00360             OSStatus s = MIDISend(outputPort, outputEndpoint, packetList);
00361             NSLogError(s, @"Sending MIDI");
00362         }
00363     }
00364 }

00370 NSUInteger ListInterfaces(id<MidiInputDelegate> delegate)
00371 {
00372 //#define PGLog NSLog
00373 #define PGLog(...) [delegate midiInput:nil event:[NSString stringWithFormat:__VA_ARGS__]]
00374     PGLog(@"%s: # external devices=%u", __func__, MIDIGetNumberOfExternalDevices());
00375     PGLog(@"%s: # devices=%u",          __func__, MIDIGetNumberOfDevices());
00376     PGLog(@"%s: # sources=%u",          __func__, MIDIGetNumberOfSources());
00377     PGLog(@"%s: # destinations=%u",     __func__, MIDIGetNumberOfDestinations());
00378 
00379     MIDIClientRef  client = 0;
00380     CFStringRef    clientName = (CFStringRef)@"MIDI Updater";
00381     MIDINotifyProc notifyProc = nil;
00382     OSStatus s = MIDIClientCreate(clientName, notifyProc, nil, &client);
00383     NSLogError(s, @"Creating MIDI client");
00384 
00385     for (ItemCount index = 0; index < MIDIGetNumberOfExternalDevices(); ++index)
00386     {
00387         PGLog(@"%s: External device %u", __func__, index);
00388         MIDIDeviceRef device = MIDIGetDevice(index);
00389         if (device)
00390         {
00391             //CFRelease(device);
00392         }
00393     }
00394 
00395     for (ItemCount index = 0; index < MIDIGetNumberOfDestinations(); ++index)
00396     {
00397         MIDIEndpointRef endpoint = MIDIGetDestination(index);
00398         if (endpoint)
00399         {
00400             PGLog(@"%s: Destination index %u", __func__, index);
00401             CFStringRef name = nil;
00402             OSStatus s = MIDIObjectGetStringProperty(endpoint, kMIDIPropertyName, &name);
00403             if (s)
00404                 NSLogError(s, @"Getting dest name");
00405             else
00406                 PGLog(@"Name=%@", name);
00407             CFRelease(name);
00408 
00409             CFPropertyListRef properties = nil;
00410             s = MIDIObjectGetProperties(endpoint, &properties, true);
00411             if (s)
00412                 NSLogError(s, @"Getting properties");
00413             else
00414                 PGLog(@"Properties=%@", properties);
00415             CFRelease(properties); properties = nil;
00416 
00417             MIDIEntityRef entity = 0;
00418             s = MIDIEndpointGetEntity(endpoint, &entity);
00419 
00420             s = MIDIObjectGetProperties(entity, &properties, true);
00421             if (s)
00422                 NSLogError(s, @"Getting entity properties");
00423             else
00424                 PGLog(@"Entity properties=%@", properties);
00425             CFRelease(properties); properties = nil;
00426 
00427             SInt32 offline = 0;
00428             s = MIDIObjectGetIntegerProperty(endpoint, kMIDIPropertyOffline, &offline);
00429             if (s)
00430                 NSLogError(s, @"Getting offline properties");
00431             else
00432                 PGLog(@"Entity offline=%d", offline);
00433 
00434             //CFRelease(entity); entity = nil;
00435 
00436             //CFRelease(endpoint);
00437             //PGLog(@"Done");
00438         }
00439     }
00440 
00441     if (client)
00442         MIDIClientDispose(client);
00443 
00444     PGLog(@"Found all interfaces");
00445 
00446     return MIDIGetNumberOfDestinations();
00447 }

00495 MIDIControllerInternal::MIDIControllerInternal(const int midiChannel, const int controllerNumber,
00496                          const float minVal, const float maxVal,
00497                          const ExternalControlSource::Warp warp, void* port) throw()
00498 : ExternalControlSourceInternal(minVal, maxVal, warp),
00499   midiChannel_(midiChannel),
00500   controllerNumber_(controllerNumber),
00501   port_(port)
00502 {
00503 }
00504 
00505 void MIDIControllerInternal::handleIncomingMidiMessage (void* source, ByteArray const& message) throw()
00506 { 
00507   if(port_ != 0 && port_ != source) return;
00508   
00509   int head = 0;
00510   
00511   // no running status in iOS core midi?
00512   
00513   while(head < message.length())
00514   {
00515     unsigned char status = message[head++];
00516     
00517     bool isStatus = status & 0x80;
00518     
00519     int type = isStatus ? (status & 0xF0) : 0xF0; // default to system since this is partial sysex?   
00520     
00521     int value1, value2;
00522     
00523     switch(type)
00524     {
00525       // system
00526       case 0xF0: {
00527         
00528         while(head < message.length())
00529         {
00530           if(message[head] & 0xF0)
00531           {
00532             break;
00533           }
00534           else
00535           {
00536             head++;
00537           }
00538         }
00539         
00540         continue; // next message...
00541         
00542       } break;
00543         
00544       // program and channel pressure
00545       case 0xC0: case 0xD0: {
00546         value1 = message[head++];
00547         value2 = 0;
00548       } break;
00549         
00550       // note off, note on, aftertouch, controller, pitch wheel
00551       case 0x80: case 0x90: case 0xA0: case 0xB0: case 0xE0: {
00552         value1 = message[head++];
00553         value2 = message[head++];
00554       } break;
00555     }
00556     
00557     int channel = (status & 0x0F) + 1;
00558     
00559     if(channel != midiChannel_)   continue; // channel
00560     if(type != 0xB0)        continue; // control change
00561     if(value1 != controllerNumber_) continue; // controller number
00562           
00563     setNormalisedValue(value2 / 127.f);
00564   }
00565 }

00688   
00689   if(midiMessages.length() > 0)

00691     handleIncomingMidiMessage(0, midiMessages);
00692     
00693     lock();

00707 void VoicerUGenInternal::handleIncomingMidiMessage (void* source, ByteArray const& message) throw()
00708 { 
00709   static const float normalise127 = 1.f / 127.f;
00710   static const float normalise8192 = 1.f / 8192.f;
00711   
00712   int head = 0;
00713   
00714   // no running status in iOS core midi?
00715   
00716   while(head < message.length())
00717   {
00718     unsigned char status = message[head++];
00719     
00720     bool isStatus = status & 0x80;
00721     int type = isStatus ? (status & 0xF0) : 0xF0; // default to system since this is partial sysex?   
00722     int value1, value2;
00723     
00724     switch(type)
00725     {
00726       case 0xF0: { // system
00727         while(head < message.length())
00728         {
00729           if(message[head] & 0xF0)
00730           {
00731             break;
00732           }
00733           else
00734           {
00735             head++;
00736           }
00737         }
00738         
00739         continue; // next message...
00740       } break;
00741         // program and channel pressure
00742       case 0xC0: case 0xD0: {
00743         value1 = message[head++];
00744         value2 = 0;
00745       } break;
00746         // note off, note on, aftertouch, controller, pitch wheel
00747       case 0x80: case 0x90: case 0xA0: case 0xB0: case 0xE0: {
00748         value1 = message[head++];
00749         value2 = message[head++];
00750       } break;
00751     }
00752     
00753     int channel = (status & 0x0F) + 1;
00754     
00755     if(channel != midiChannel_) continue; // channel    
00756     
00757     if((type == 0x80) || (type == 0x90))
00758     {
00759       int velocity = (type == 0x90) ? value2 : 0;
00760        
00761       lock();
00762       {
00763         sendMidiNote(channel, value1, velocity);
00764       }
00765       unlock();
00766     }
00767     else if(type == 0xB0)
00768     {
00769       getController(value1) = ((float)value2 * normalise127);
00770     }
00771     else if(type == 0xC0)
00772     {
00773       getProgram() = (value1); // locks internally
00774     }
00775     else if(type == 0xD0)
00776     {
00777       getKeyPressure(value1) = ((float)value2 * normalise127);
00778     }
00779     else if(type == 0xE0)
00780     {
00781       int wheel = (value2 << 7) | value1;
00782       wheel -= 8192;
00783       getPitchWheel() = ((float)wheel * normalise8192);
00784     }   
00785   } 
00786 }

00788 void VoicerUGenInternal::sendMidiBuffer(ByteArray const& midiMessagesToAdd) throw()
00789 { 
00790   if(midiMessagesToAdd.length() > 0)
00791   {     
00792     lock();
00793     {
00794       midiMessages.add(midiMessagesToAdd);
00795     }
00796     unlock();   
00797   }
00798 }
